method: 2 warmups + 9 randomized interleaved fresh-process samples per engine. performance.now measures sort only. Matrix: identical pre-generated JSON inputs; every output element, type and stable object order checked against Node. Issue 289: each engine constructs the original negative-number input; the program verifies every output element. Matching compiler/runtime pairs and identical build flags; source differences are the intended optimization patch.
build_command: LLVM_SYS_221_PREFIX=/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@22 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16 CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off cargo build --release -p perry -p perry-runtime-static -p perry-stdlib-static -j4
host_load_note: Other user workloads were running on this shared host. The harness interleaves engines and retains every sample; ratios are local measurements, not isolated-machine or cross-platform guarantees.

targeted_previous_candidate_comparison.method: 15 randomized interleaved fresh-process samples after two warmups, with complete canonical JSON output comparison. The previous/current candidate labels correspond to next-16/next-17 frozen matching builds.
